reviewer: feedback56_axis_review; direct view_image inspection of every listed pose image
scope: Batch non-LMG authored model barrel/up axes, exact configuration provenance and gaps. Supports aim-only visual alignment; no native writes, firing, grip, holster or headset acceptance.
coordinate_convention: canonical reflected-Z row-vector metres; named bone relative to jntWpn_1
method: Every listed geometry PNG was directly inspected in view_image in six batches; both SIDE and TOP projections were checked.
Per-pose barrel/stock/receiver and upper sight versus lower grip features determine direction; no universal class default was applied.
Numerical wrist coordinates and image labels establish signed projection axes. The named mesh/skeleton identities and hashes bind each image to the source row.
Detached flash origins (including M416, USAS12, MP412 and some UGL poses) are excluded from direction proof. Typed raw firing +Z is metadata corroboration only, never native trajectory proof.

Other configurations are joined only through exact mesh content, LOD0 content, skeleton, rig fingerprint, jntWpn_1, canonical coordinate convention and one-state source binding; typed configuration joins are separately reported.
The four existing AEK/XM8/SCAR/Nambu reviews are reported for preservation; no duplicate runtime edits or prior-review rewrites were made.
